name: Patelco Credit Union
description: We are the 6th largest credit union and have 38 branches in the Northern California area. Our mission to to educate our members about financial freedom and help them get there with product knowledge and options to achieve goals. Our products are intended individuals from all walks of life- from mortgage, auto and personal lines/loans to rebuilding credit. We love helping the community and being a resource. When coming to PACT we are offering $100 to establish a checking account once $100 is deposited as a reward. We are also working on piloting and being able to use inmate ID cards as many may not currently have CA issued identification once released.

name: A.K. Bean Foundation
description: A.K. Bean Foundation offers alcohol, drug and tobacco education classes at offices in Fairfield, Vacaville and Vallejo, California. Our state-licensed programs are taught by certified counselors for DUI offenders in an effort to reduce their chances of re-offending. Our vision is to enhance the public safety of our communities by providing high quality education on alcohol, drugs and tobacco through best practices. By making our clients accountable for their actions, we will reduce driving while impaired (DWI), recidivism and related arrests. We support positive changes in lifestyle and protect the public’s health on roadways and highways.
who_it_serves: Adults and youth returning from incarceration
